title: Minimax Sample Complexity for Orienting Many Independent Nonlinear Cause-Effect Pairs
banked_reason: terminal:laundering — the promised full separated restricted-ANM all-procedure frontier was replaced by a matched frontier only on the strict Hermite-chart subclass; the full class receives only a lower bound.
gap_reasons: The promised all-procedure frontier N^*(d,alpha,lambda) on the separated restricted-ANM envelope is replaced by a matched upper/lower frontier only for the strict Hermite-chart subclass M_d^H(lambda); the full class receives only a lower bound.
No faithful same-topic bounded repair is presently available.
Proving these is the unresolved research kernel, not a bounded correction.
proof_attempt_summary: The run constructed and audited an attainable GENE-inspired/HSIC margin rectangle, a matched orientation frontier and simultaneous confidence set on a sub-half Hermite chart, and a fixed-local-polynomial protocol counterexample. It collapsed at D0.5 because the advertised field contribution required the matching upper bound and confidence procedure uniformly over the broader separated restricted-ANM envelope, whereas only the lower bound transferred there. A future retry must supply a genuinely full-class density-adaptive or orthogonal residual-HSIC construction with reverse-regression regularity, unbounded-envelope concentration, and uniform all-query deviation control.
tldr: For \(d\) supplied independent cause--effect pairs, the orientation-permuted Hermite chart fills a local rectangle of GENE-inspired gains and fixed-Gaussian-kernel residual-HSIC margins. On the explicit sub-half chart \(\mathcal M_d^{\mathrm H}(\lambda)\), the observable antisymmetric moment and a median-of-means rule yield the unconditional matched all-procedure frontier \(N_{\mathrm H}^*(d,\alpha,\lambda)\asymp\lambda^{-1}\log((d+1)/\alpha)\) and a computable \(O(dn)\) simultaneous confidence set with the same singleton transition. The product-testing lower bound, but not the chart estimator or confidence set, transfers to the larger separated restricted-ANM class. Separately, one fixed chart law makes the compulsory regression-good event in the prescribed four-fold local-polynomial/orthogonalization probability guarantee fail with limiting probability above \(2/e\); this is only a fixed-protocol obstruction.
gap: Published ANM theory supplies qualitative direction identification and pointwise consistency, while published HSIC minimax theory treats observed variables. Acharya et al.'s discrete intervention experiment and Jin's linear-LiNGAM primitive-margin experiment do not determine the coupled GENE--residual-HSIC feasible image or the product exact-recovery boundary for nonlinear observational ANMs.
fill: The orientation-indexed permutation, scalar-coordinate Hermite expansions, attainable rectangle, and legal-mirror product converse form the unconditional contribution. The conditional upper result is pinned to \(\mathcal A_n^{\mathrm{LP}}\), whose four-fold allocation, polynomial order, bandwidth, tail truncation, boundary correction, ridge rule, and clipping are fixed. Constructing the orthogonal statistic must jointly prove \(\mathcal G_n(x;C_m,\widehat m)\) and the dimension-correct \(u=x+\log(2d)\) deviation bound before the matched frontier or singleton confidence guarantee follows; the latter claims use the same event and require \(u_{d,\alpha}\le c_u n\).
